title: RecHarness: A Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2607.29241v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Optimizing recommender models remains heavily reliant on manual iteration over architectures, objectives, and training strategies. While LLM-based agents can automate this trial-and-error process, relying on LLMs to both select modification directions and formulate concrete hypotheses can lead to unstable search under limited trial budgets. Inspired by the above challenge, we propose RecHarness, a Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for automated recommender model optimization. RecHarness decouples the optimization process into two steps: a bandit router selects the next modification direction according to historical validation feedback, while the LLM generates a concrete optimization hypothesis and executable code edit within the selected direction. translated_title: RecHarness：一种用于自演化推荐系统的多臂老虎机路由智能体框架
translated_abstract: 优化推荐模型仍然严重依赖于对架构、目标和训练策略的人工迭代。虽然基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体可以自动化这一试错过程，但依赖LLM同时选择修改方向和制定具体假设，在有限的试验预算下可能导致不稳定的搜索。受上述挑战的启发，我们提出了RecHarness，一个用于自动化推荐模型优化的多臂老虎机路由智能体框架。RecHarness将优化过程解耦为两个步骤：多臂老虎机路由器根据历史验证反馈选择下一个修改方向，而LLM则在所选方向内生成具体的优化假设和可执行的代码修改。为了维持长期探索，RecHarness使用跳跃盆地（jump-basin）机制，在局部编辑陷入停滞时激活结构跳跃臂。在多个推荐任务、数据集和……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出RecHarness框架，通过将优化过程解耦为“多臂老虎机路由器选择修改方向+LLM生成具体优化假设与代码修改”两个步骤，并借助跳跃盆地机制在局部优化停滞时触发结构性跳跃，实现推荐模型的自演化自动优化。
